# Coolify configuration and recovery evidence — 2026-11-04

**Method:** read-only root SSH to the known VPS, `docker inspect` mount/network metadata and `docker compose -f <generated file> config --format json` parsed in memory. Only allowlisted service names, image tags, variable **names**, network/mount metadata, restart/healthcheck presence, and backup file metadata were emitted. No secret values or raw Compose were saved. This extends the [dated Docker census](coolify-host-inventory-2026-11-04.md); it does **not** verify Coolify's saved database definition or a restore.

| Service / source | Observed generated/deployed configuration and dependencies | Persistence / recovery boundary |
|---|---|---|
| n8n + external runner, generated `/data/coolify/services/n44wksswcocwk88ogcog8c48/docker-compose.yml` | n8n `2.44.6`; runner locally built, depends on n8n in Compose; both on private stack network and `coolify-shared`, restart `unless-stopped`. Cross-stack Postgres is via shared network, **not** Compose `depends_on`. No Compose healthcheck declared for either. Config names include `N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, `N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN`, `DB_POSTGRESDB_*`, `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_*`; values omitted. | n8n named volume `n44wksswcocwk88ogcog8c48_n8n-data` → `/home/node/.n8n`; DB is separate Postgres stack. Both DB and volume plus matching encryption key are necessary for recovery. |
| PostgreSQL, generated `/data/coolify/services/uokgs4c04ko0s4scccg40cgg/docker-compose.yml` | `postgres:17.7`; private stack + `coolify-shared`; Compose healthcheck present; restart `unless-stopped`. Config names `POSTGRES_DB`, `POSTGRES_USER`, `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`. | `uokgs4c04ko0s4scccg40cgg_postgres-data` → `/var/lib/postgresql/data`; multiple DB consumers documented in project records, not a fresh schema audit. |
| reports, generated `/data/coolify/applications/v3ud1lum1svamymuor21upog/docker-compose.yaml` | Deployed image `...:executive-v1-20261019-opportunity-actions`; generated Compose lists `coolify`, but live Docker network metadata also lists `coolify-shared`—**unresolved generated-vs-running drift**. No Compose healthcheck; restart `unless-stopped`. | No mount observed: rebuild requires source/static assets and image/deployment recipe. Report-to-n8n route is documented in `reports/nginx.conf`; live route bytes were not inspected here. |
| Sales Navigator media, `/srv/livetransparent/sales-navigator-media/docker-compose.yml` | Local build on `coolify-shared`, restart `unless-stopped`; config **names** include `MEDIA_SERVICE_KEY`, `MEDIA_DATA_DIR`, `PUBLIC_BASE_URL`. | Bind `/srv/livetransparent/sales-navigator-media/data` → `/data`; backup coverage **unknown**. |
| sample landing preview | Coolify application Compose image `localhost:5000/livetransparent-sample-landing:review`, `coolify` network, restart `unless-stopped`, no mount. | Review-only; local registry has its own Docker volume. No deletion or service change. |
| Coolify control plane / proxy | Census shows Coolify 4.6.0, its PostgreSQL 15/Redis 7 and Traefik 3.6.11. | `coolify-db`, `coolify-redis` named volumes; control-plane backup coverage not verified. |

**Backup metadata only:** `/root/n8n-upgrade-backups/` contains a dated pre-2.44.6 Postgres custom dump (~1.11 GB), n8n data tar (~5.94 MB), and Compose copy. This is a **one-time pre-upgrade set**, not evidence of a scheduled backup or a successful restore. File names/sizes/date were read; archive integrity, database completeness, off-host copies, encryption-key custody, backup schedule, retention, and restore procedure/test are **unverified**. No backup was extracted or restored.

**Configuration/drift gaps:** generated n8n Compose and live image agree on `2.44.6`; a dated October 26 record says Coolify's saved `docker_compose_raw` was corrected, but it was **not freshly read** here, so saved-vs-generated parity remains open. The checked-in `n8n/docker-compose.yml` is a reference, not proof of deployed settings. In particular, Compose `depends_on` does not protect n8n against cross-stack Postgres outages. Routes use Traefik labels (keys observed); live host rules, TLS/DNS/firewall, all Coolify project resource records, image digests, DB schema/roles, and backup schedules still need a credential-safe readback. Restore readiness cannot be accepted until a controlled isolated restore is planned and separately authorized.
